input.disc_id_interpretation: Validated raw Wii disc header: disc ID RM3E01, disc number 0, revision 0, and Wii disc magic. This confirms the header revision, not the encrypted partition DOL hash.

verification.read_only_scan: SHA-256 computed by opening the ISO read-only; no ISO content was written or extracted.

limitations: The runtime DVD HLE still expects an extracted DATA directory and is not connected to direct ISO reads.
The DOL inside the encrypted partition has not yet been compared with the pinned RM3E01_00 main.dol.
The RVZ alongside the ISO was not opened or modified.
